title: Let a slow exchange rate end its pause, and only its own

cases.says: a quote that arrives in time reaches the next participants with its rate
without a quote the participant's own timeout lets the purchase go on without a rate
a failed quote lets the purchase go on without a rate
a quote that arrives after the timeout must not resume the transaction again, or the issuer's pause ends before the issuer answers
a timeout that fires after a failure must not resume the transaction again: whether a rate arrived is not whether the pause already ended

origin.section: 15.6 A Paused Transaction Resumes Once, and an Extra `resume()` Is Kept for the Next Pause
